fact: DNEC says a biometric population file has been built from the civil register and more than 20 million NINA have been attributed through the CTDEC/ANSAEC, one body holding the RAVEC database.

The Ministry of Territorial Administration's page gives ANSAEC (and the Civil Status Data Processing Center before it) the mission of building the civil status database of registered persons and assigning each person in it a National Identification Number with the national statistics service.
